description: Can only be cast once in the lifetime of the caster, and only in the instant before death. The form has the Attributes of the hungry ghost that would rise from the necromancer's corpse with her Essence added to Strength and Stamina, (her Essence x 5) -0 health levels and a single Incapacitated level, and lets her use any of her Charms for a cost of 1 mote (or spend a single mote in place of Willpower). If the form is destroyed, her soul is devoured by the Void without exception; if she survives, the spell is scoured from her memory and is active only for one scene.

name: Black Faith
description: After half an hour of silent worship preceded by the sacrifice of one ghost's pain and corpus to the Abyss, the necromancer cuts himself and leaps into the Void. If his actions have pleased the Malfeans, they revoke his dissolution and he appears wherever he needs to be — wards have no effect on his arrival; otherwise he is irrevocably dead.

name: Forsaken Life Engine
description: Conjures a vast bone engine that creates a shadowland centered on itself with a radius of 50 miles, plus 50 miles for every additional 10 motes spent in the casting. The engine must be fed a series of living creatures with a total permanent Essence of no less than 10 times the Essence spent creating it; it soaks 22L/30B, needs 60 health levels of damage to be disabled, and Obsidian Countermagic destroys it instantly while Adamant Countermagic inflicts 10 health levels per invocation. If destroyed or not completed by the time the sun reaches its zenith the spell fails, and it has no effect when cast in the Underworld.

name: Grandmother Void
description: For a number of turns equal to her Essence the caster becomes a flat, empty doorway into Oblivion from which two fully material spectres are spawned each turn, each built as a starting ghost with additional experience equal to (her Essence x 7). Ghosts who hear the spectres' whispers must roll Willpower + Essence against a difficulty of 5 or become tainted; while flat the caster is immune to physical and mental assaults, and countermagic ends the spell but does not dispel spectres already brought forth.

name: Mouth of the Void
description: Darkness fills a 40-yard radius and falls into the sky, blotting out all light within its boundary; each living creature within its reach but the caster suffers 30 levels of aggravated damage. The earth that fell under the shadow is left rotting and pitted, strewn with the obsidian remains of any creature the spell killed.

name: Pyre-Flame Guardian
description: Covers the caster in soulsteel armor granting +12L/+12B soak and ignoring all attacks that do less than 12 dice of raw damage, with a Strength bonus equal to his Essence; barehanded attackers suffer three dice of aggravated damage, and hurled balls of pyre flame (accuracy equal to the caster's Essence, three health levels of aggravated damage plus one die per extra success) cannot be parried without Charms. The spell ends when the caster cancels it, after an hour, or when struck by Obsidian Countermagic, whereupon all creatures within 30 yards suffer five levels of lethal and two levels of aggravated damage.

name: Risen and Screaming
description: Sows a circle of land with lasting undeath; any creature that dies within the boundary rises scant minutes later as a zombie under the necromancer's control. The zombies move at twice the speed of normal zombies, scream loudly when they see prey, cannot leave the circle (instantly becoming inanimate if forced outside), and bury themselves in the earth when idle (a Perception + Awareness roll at difficulty two is required to notice one); the enclosed area returns to normal after one week per point of the necromancer's Essence.

name: Sins of the Father
description: Lays a curse of eternal servitude upon a living creature: a scar that never heals appears, and identical scars appear on all the victim's descendants. On death the victim infallibly becomes a ghost with the Passion Obey She Who Cursed Me at a rating equal to his Conviction and the Fetter Master of rating •••••, forced to obey every command given him. Celestial Exalted cannot be enslaved but can be marked and pass the curse on to their children, and creatures without souls — such as Dragon Kings or the Mountain Folk — cannot be affected by this spell.

name: Summon Hekatonkhire
description: A six-hour ritual, ending at dusk, that requires the death of both a mortal and a ghost (or a single Ghost-Blooded). The necromancer and the summoned hekatonkhire enter a contested Willpower + Essence test rolled each turn, the necromancer able to spend Essence in 7-mote increments to reduce the creature's dice pool by one die each; if the caster accumulates three more successes than the beast, it serves her loyally for a year and a day or is set to a single task of indefinite duration.

name: The Clay of Warped Dreams
description: With a minimum of three sacrificial ghosts behind him, the necromancer gains total control over 10 square miles of the Labyrinth, shaping it to his waking dreams and manifesting physical attacks (a Wits + Melee, Archery or Thrown roll, with additional successes equal to his Occult score). This control endures as long as he commits the Essence.

name: Becoming the Wood Friend
description: Grants empathy with wood and woodlands: the caster can move unhindered at top speed without Athletics and gains a Strength bonus equal to her Essence for jumping and a Dexterity bonus for movement in forests. She must make a Willpower roll to harm plants, and cutting live wood or setting fires instantly ends the spell and its blessings.

name: Blood Lash
description: Requires prior lethal damage: an extra lethal health level is committed and does not heal until the spell ends. The whip moves at a speed equal to the caster's Occult, with +1 accuracy and +1 defense, a base lethal damage of Strength + permanent Essence + current lethal health levels, and a range equal to the caster's Willpower in yards; no other spells may be cast while it is active, and it lasts one scene.

name: Burning Eyes of the Offender
description: Enemies within 100 yards suffer a difficulty penalty equal to the caster's permanent Essence on all rolls for 10 minutes. Attackers who close their eyes suffer a -2 blind penalty.

name: Calling the Wind's Kiss

cost.raw: 10 motes + 2 motes per additional hour (maximum 20 additional motes)

description: Calls a wind that lasts a number of hours equal to the caster's permanent Essence, adding three dice to Sail rolls for a vessel within Essence x 3 miles or imposing a three-die penalty on enemies. A spirit of air may commandeer the wind.

name: Commanding the Beasts
description: Commands up to (Essence x 2) animals within 20 yards, which must be of Intelligence 1 or less, for one scene. The spell has no effect on Wyld-shaped, magical, undead or similar creatures.

name: Conjuring the Azure Chariot
description: Calls a chariot and steeds of Essence that carry up to 200 pounds per point of the caster's permanent Essence and travel at 200 mph; it may only be cast during daylight and lasts while the sun is up. The chariot has 25 health levels, 25L/35B soak and provides 90 percent cover.

name: Corrupted Words
description: The victim cannot speak of a single subject; if he tries, he vomits maggots. Breaking free requires a Stamina + Resistance roll against a difficulty equal to the caster's Occult, and the effect lasts until countermagic is cast or the caster dies.

name: Curse of Slavish Humility
description: Compels the victim to worship and grovel before the caster: the caster rolls Charisma + Occult at a difficulty equal to her permanent Essence, and the victim suffers a -3 penalty to all Social Attributes.

name: Dance of the Smoke Cobras
description: Conjures five smoke cobras that attack a single target within 30 yards; the cobras' venom must be resisted with a Stamina + Resistance roll at a difficulty equal to the caster's permanent Essence. Destroyed cobras regrow.

name: Disguise of the New Face
description: A 10-minute casting that transforms the sorcerer's face into a new one of her choosing. The difficulty for others to see through the disguise is set by an Intelligence + Larceny roll, with the sorcerer's Occult added to the successes.

name: Emerald Circle Banishment
description: A contested Willpower + Essence roll against a demon; the caster may spend extra Essence in 5-mote increments, each reducing the demon's dice pool by one die. If the demon wins, the sorcerer may not try again for five days; Sapphire and Adamant versions of the spell cost 15 and 20 motes respectively.

name: Eye of Alliance
description: Links up to (Essence x 2) participants so that they share emotions through crystals. Each crystal requires a commitment of 1 mote and remains viable for a year and a day.

name: Flight of Separation
description: Transforms the caster into a flock of birds that can travel up to 20 mph and cover a number of miles equal to her permanent Essence; while in this form she can only move and dodge. The number of birds is her Essence plus her health levels times 10.

name: Flight of the Brilliant Raptor
description: Targets a creature within 1,800 yards with a brilliant raptor of Essence; the attack has a base lethal damage of Perception + Occult plus automatic damage equal to the caster's permanent Essence, and the impact explodes in a 3-yard burst. A Stamina + Resistance roll at difficulty 3 resists the explosion.

name: Flying Guillotine
description: Hurls a crescent blade at a target within 500 yards, dealing base 18 lethal damage; a target reduced below Incapacitated is decapitated. The blade can travel 500 yards per turn.

name: Food from the Aerial Table
description: Conjures 5 servings of food; each additional 5 motes and one extra turn adds 10 servings. The food remains fresh for a number of days equal to the caster's permanent Essence and cannot be poisoned.

name: Fugue of Truth
description: After a one-hour meditation the caster gains +4 Perception against magical deception, +3 against non-magical lies and +2 against First Age artifacts, but suffers -2 to attacks, dodges and Athletics and -1 to Social rolls while the fugue holds.

name: Hound of the Five Winds
description: Creates an automaton tracker of Essence that can track prey up to 100 miles away for 8 hours; the hound cannot be healed. When it dies or the spell ends, everyone within 3 yards suffers 5 bashing damage.

name: Hypnotic Piping
description: Bone pipes inscribed with the 555 names of Luna, each holding a jewel (one per point of the caster's permanent Essence, committed at 3 motes each), can be played for up to 5 turns; mortals must roll Willpower against a difficulty equal to the number of turns played. The spell has no effect on undead, automata or creatures of Intelligence less than 2, and lasts a day-and-a-night.

name: Incantation of Spiritual Discretion
description: A six-hour ritual that traces a boundary of salt, blocking Dematerialize and shadow-form within a radius equal to the caster's Occult + permanent Essence, for a number of days equal to his Occult + permanent Essence. The spell has no effect on creatures of greater Essence and may not be cast at a sanctum or with spirits present.

name: Internal Flame
description: Sets a target's internal Essence alight: the caster rolls Willpower + Occult against a difficulty equal to the target's Stamina, for base 3 lethal damage plus the successes, soakable only by natural soak. The flame continues to inflict 1 lethal per turn for a number of turns equal to the caster's permanent Essence or until medical attention, the target suffers a -2 penalty for the scene, and mortals die within a month without magical healing.

name: Lightning Spider
description: Creates a spider of lightning with eight legs that can climb any surface and gains +5 dice to resist clinches; its dragline supports 100 pounds per mote spent (to a maximum equal to the caster's permanent Essence). The spider has 10L/10B soak and 15 health levels.

name: Manifestations of Vigorous Design
description: Animates an object of up to 10 pounds per point of Essence, granting it Physical Attributes of 1 dot per 5 pounds and one Ability equal to the caster's permanent Essence (no higher than the caster's own rating). Each additional Ability costs 5 motes, to a maximum of 20 motes.

name: Mast-Shattering Spell
description: Targets a ship within 1 mile; those within 20 yards must dodge at difficulty 1 or suffer 10 lethal damage, and the oar variant inflicts 5 lethal damage.

name: Mists of Eventide
description: A 10-yard circle of mist sends those within into a deep sleep lasting until the sun next sets and rises; those awakened suffer a -3 penalty. No Essence is regained during the sleep, and the spell has no effect on Fair Folk, undead, intangible creatures or automata.

name: Paralyzing Contradiction
description: Paralyzes creatures of Intelligence greater than 1 within 50 yards; each victim rolls Intelligence + Lore against a cumulative difficulty equal to the caster's permanent Essence. A victim is freed if attacked, and automata are unaffected.

name: Personal Tempest
description: Surrounds the caster in a personal storm that provides 90 percent cover (-2 to hand-to-hand and -4 to ranged attacks against her) and halves her movement; it lasts one scene.

name: Plague of Bronze Snakes
description: Bronze serpents hunt human-raised livestock at night only, and the spell may only be cast at night; the number of serpents equals twice the caster's Willpower, they hunt for a number of nights equal to the caster's permanent Essence, and their venom turns to granite. The range is 1,800 yards per point of the caster's Occult.

name: Private Plaza of Downcast Eyes
description: A six-hour ritual that raises a warding blocking scrying, clairvoyance and teleportation for a number of days equal to the caster's permanent Essence; the ward may be renewed with a one-hour ritual and a further 20 motes.

name: Ritual of Elemental Empowerment
description: A dawn-to-noon ritual that empowers a mundane item of up to 5 pounds per point of the caster's Essence with an elemental spirit of Essence 3 or more; the item is struck five times, each strike costing 5 motes. An item can bear only one enchantment — the spell may replace an enchantment but not add to one.

name: River of Blood
description: Turns a flowing river (not standing pools) into blood for a number of miles equal to the caster's permanent Essence, at a cost of 3 motes per mile; anyone within a mile must make a daily Stamina + Endurance roll at difficulty 2. The river reverts after a number of days equal to the caster's Willpower.

name: The Sacred Tongue
description: Grants the ability to speak and be understood in any language, adding one die to Manipulation rolls; the caster wears a golden mask.

name: Shadow Summons
description: Requires an arcane link: in a ritual cast from midnight to moonset, the caster pulls the victim's shadow away from his body. The shadow may serve as a messenger or be destroyed, imposing a penalty equal to the caster's permanent Essence for one week, and the shadow regrows over one lunar month.

name: Silent Words of Dreams and Nightmares
description: Requires an arcane link; sends the target dreams or nightmares, though the victim cannot be directly controlled. Night terrors force a Willpower roll at a difficulty equal to the caster's permanent Essence, with the victim losing temporary Willpower equal to the caster's Essence.

name: Sleep of Stony Safety
description: May only be cast at night and ends at dawn; a one-minute casting wraps the caster in a stone cocoon. Each additional creature protected costs 5 motes, up to a maximum equal to the caster's Willpower; the dome has soak 15 and 30 health levels and ignores attacks dealing less than 5 damage.

name: Sorcerer's Irresistible Puppetry
description: A ritual with paper and incense (Resources ••) and a jewel focus that lets the caster possess a living creature of Essence for up to 24 hours; the caster rolls Willpower + Occult against a difficulty equal to the target's Willpower + permanent Essence. The spell has no effect on undead, automata, plants or dematerialized creatures.

name: Spirit of Might
description: Flaring her anima banner to its fullest, the caster gains a feat-of-strength bonus of Willpower + permanent Essence to Strength + Athletics rolls; each additional 2 motes adds one dot, to a maximum of 30 motes. The effect lasts a number of turns equal to her Occult.

name: Spirit Sword
description: An intangible sword with base lethal damage of Willpower + successes, speed +3, accuracy +2 and defense +2; it can only cut creatures with an Essence-Trait, cannot be parried by non-magical weapons, and harms dematerialized ghosts. Lasts one scene.

name: Sprouting Shackles of Doom
description: Vines sprout from the ground and clinch a target within 30 yards; a Perception + Occult roll with automatic successes equal to the caster's permanent Essence determines the clinch, and the vines' damage ignores armor.

name: The Spy Who Walks in Darkness
description: A three-hour ritual at full moon creates a shadow automaton that serves for a number of days equal to the caster's Intelligence + Occult; while it is active the caster has no shadow. The caster may possess the spy for 5 motes, taking no other actions; if the spy is countered or slain the caster loses 1 temporary Willpower and suffers 2 bashing damage, or suffers bashing damage equal to the damage and a 2-point temporary Willpower loss if he was possessing it.

name: Sting of the Ice Hornet
description: A hornet of ice strikes a target within 300 yards (able to travel 500 yards), dealing base 12 lethal plus the successes; the attack cannot be parried and ignores cover, and dodging requires a roll at difficulty 2 plus the caster's successes.

name: Summoning the Lesser Minions of the Eyeless Face
description: A six-hour ritual using oil (Resources •••) summons a number of automata equal to the caster's permanent Essence + Charisma; they serve for a year and a day and cannot speak.

name: The Horse that Travels Earth and Water
description: Calls a lesser air elemental in the form of a horse that never tires, travels over water and lasts until the next sunrise. The horse is not a pack animal.

name: The Tree's Many Branches
description: Grants extra pairs of arms for one scene: each pair adds +1 initiative, reduces the multi-action penalty by 2 dice, and grants one -0 health level. The maximum number of pairs equals the caster's permanent Essence.

name: Theft of Memory
description: Steals a memory into an emerald (Resources ••); the caster rolls Charisma + Occult against a difficulty equal to the target's Willpower, and only that creature can regain the memory by swallowing the emerald. Charm and spell memories cannot be stolen, and the spell cannot be cast in combat.

name: Thunder Wolf's Howl
description: A howl strikes a 20-yard area within 100 yards; Intelligence + Occult successes determine the levels of bashing damage, which ignores armor and cannot be parried or dodged. Undead and inanimate objects halve their soak, and a failed Stamina + Resistance roll imposes a two-die penalty for a number of turns equal to the successes.

name: Unbreakable Bones of Stone
description: Until the sun next crosses the horizon the caster gains a Strength and Stamina bonus equal to his permanent Essence, halves wound penalties and falling damage, and weighs 50 percent more.

name: Unconquerable Self
description: The caster immolates herself in a burst of Essence, leaving no ghost; Celestial Exalted reincarnate, and objects not possessed by the caster are unharmed.

name: Unstoppable Fountain of the Depths
description: A jet of water 10 feet wide and 5 feet high slams into the target: Perception + Occult with automatic successes equal to the caster's permanent Essence, base 10 bashing, and a failed Stamina + Resistance roll at difficulty 5 knocks the target down. After 10 minutes the fountain becomes a stream that continues for a number of days equal to the caster's permanent Essence.

name: Viridian Mantle of Underwater Journeys
description: Wraps allies (up to the caster's permanent Essence in number, within 3 yards) in a mantle granting +1L/2B soak that does not stack with armor; it lasts while the wearers remain immersed.

name: Virtuous Guardian of Flame
description: Calls a flame guardian that lasts until the next crossing of the horizon; it provides 75 percent cover against ranged attacks and parries hand-to-hand attacks using the target's Occult + Essence, parried barehanded attacks dealing 4 lethal damage. It parries a number of attacks per turn equal to the caster's Essence, and is not intelligent — it cannot defend against both ranged and hand-to-hand attacks at once.

name: Between the Minute and the Hour
description: Views past events from a location; the caster can see back a number of minutes equal to his Willpower, or 100 years per point of Occult. He may not view an event he has already viewed and cannot perform other actions while concentrating, and on taking damage his player must roll Stamina + Resistance at a difficulty equal to the health levels taken or lose the vision.

name: Bone Lion
description: A skeletal lion hunts the target for 101 days; the casting requires a living human sacrifice and two diamond eyes, each costing Resources ••. If the lion is slain, every piece must be destroyed or it rises again at the next sunset.

name: Cantata of Empty Voices
description: A terrifying sound affects an area 800 yards per point of the caster's permanent Essence; those within suffer 2 lethal damage at the start of each turn, soakable only by Stamina and Stamina-Charms, and a two-die penalty, for a number of turns equal to the caster's permanent Essence x 2.

name: Cloud Trapeze
description: Creates a cloud that can carry 500 pounds per point of the caster's Essence at 100 mph; hiding it requires a Wits + Occult roll with automatic successes equal to the caster's permanent Essence. The caster cannot cast spells or use Charms while maintaining it.

name: Eternal Crystalline Encasement
description: Encases an unconscious living creature in timeless crystalline stasis; the casting begins at dawn and takes all day, and the crystal encloses about 27 cubic feet. It soaks all non-magical damage and the first 50 health levels of magical damage before shattering, and a wand or Sapphire Countermagic crumbles it.

name: The Faithful Ally

cost.raw: 20 motes to cast, 20 motes to activate

description: An eight-hour ritual using sapphire dust (Resources •••) tattoos an ally with a Perception + Linguistics roll at difficulty 4, allowing the ally to transport to within 20 yards of the caster; a +5 mote cost provides an arcane link. The ally cannot cross beyond Creation, the tattoos are consumed, and the maximum number of tattoos equals the caster's permanent Essence.

name: Force of Life's Summer
description: Grows nonsentient life to full maturity. No sentient creature may be targeted, and nothing can be aged past its prime.

name: Geyser of Corruption
description: A geyser of necrotic Essence erupts beneath a target within 50 yards (Dexterity + Occult or Dexterity + Thrown to hit), in a 20-yard diameter; it ignores 5 soak and deals 8 dice of aggravated damage per turn (3 aggravated to living creatures). Clean water washes the corruption away.

name: Hideous Confusion of Tongues
description: Those in a 100-yard radius cannot speak intelligibly for a number of hours equal to twice the caster's permanent Essence, and the confusion spreads by speech; the caster and creatures of greater Essence are unaffected.

name: Imbue Amalgam
description: An all-day ritual using a statue (Resources ••••) transmutes a willing mortal of permanent Essence lower than the caster's into an amalgam servant (Exalts are immune). Additions cost: Attribute 2 motes, Ability 1, Essence 4, 5 temporary Essence 4, Charm 3, Willpower 4; the amalgam's permanent Essence cannot be raised above the caster's Essence minus 1, no more dots than the caster's Occult + Essence may be added, and sorcery above the Terrestrial Circle cannot be granted.

name: Insidious Tendrils of Hate
description: Requires an arcane link; targets a number of creatures equal to the caster's Manipulation + Essence, all within 30 yards of each other. Each must roll Willpower at a difficulty equal to the caster's permanent Essence or believe everything they are told is a lie, for a number of days equal to the caster's Manipulation.

name: Ivory Orchid Pavilion
description: Raises a mansion that can hold 100 people per point of the caster's Essence for 24 hours; its walls have 10 health levels and soak 5, are flammable, and are destroyed by Sapphire Countermagic.

name: Magma Kraken
description: Conjures a kraken of magma with 10 tentacles 15 yards long that can reach 500 yards; the tentacles have Strength 10, Dexterity equal to the caster's permanent Essence and Brawl equal to the caster's Occult, dealing raw 5 lethal + 10 + the caster's permanent Essence. The kraken ignores bashing damage, soaks the first 10 lethal damage, has 10 health levels and regenerates, and victims may be knocked over by a Dexterity + Athletics roll at difficulty 2.

name: Mercury's Deliverance
description: A barrier proof against Emerald and Sapphire Circle magic, up to 100 yards in diameter per point of the caster's Essence, lasting until the sun next crosses the horizon; it blocks teleportation, scrying and enchanted items. Only Adamant Countermagic cast from outside can breach it, though Sapphire Countermagic cast at the center dispels it.

name: Outside Worlds Within
description: Transforms a room into a pocket of any Creation environment, 50 yards radius per point of the caster's Essence, that the caster has visited or holds an organic sample of; a candle (Resources ••) is consumed. The effect lasts one month (renewable for 25 motes), and the room reverts to normal after 3 days.

name: Raise the Puissant Sanctum
description: A ritual that raises a Manse from the very elements of a Demesne; a geomantic architect must be involved in the planning unless the sorcerer has the skills, and detailed plans must be drawn up. The sorcerer meditates on the plans in seclusion for weeks equal to the level of the Manse, must be attuned to the Demesne and alone within it, and the working takes six hours per level of Manse being raised.

name: Rolling Earth Carpet
description: Unrolls a 20-yard-radius road of earth that can carry 100 marching humans or 50 mounted riders; the road lasts as long as the Essence is committed, and supernatural trackers gain +3 to track along it.

name: Servant of Infallible Location
description: Calls a sparrow of blue flame that finds anything the caster has encountered, holds an arcane link to, or that lies within 500 yards; the sparrow persists until the goal is reached.

name: Shadow Theft
description: Steals the target's shadow into a crystal globe (Resources ••) and a portrait (Resources ••); the target is pulled toward the shadow, and if separated for more than a year becomes a mindless wanderer. For 5 motes the caster can see through the target's eyes for 5 turns, and the target may block with a Willpower roll at a difficulty equal to the caster's permanent Essence.

name: Shadows of the Ancient Past
description: Creates a visual-only illusion of a past event, 20 yards radius per point of the caster's Essence; an additional 5 motes focuses the illusion on a single object.

name: Summon the Army of the Wild
description: Summons animals from up to the caster's permanent Essence in miles; they must be of Intelligence less than 2 and not magical, Wyld-shaped, sentient or familiars. The caster must join the battle, and the animals fight until the enemy or caster is slain or the sun crosses the horizon, never harming each other.

name: Summoning the Heart of Darkness
description: A column of darkness 1 mile in radius and 10 miles high descends, impairing normal vision (Valor difficulty 3 to enter) and imposing a two-die penalty on supernatural senses; others' difficulties are increased by the caster's permanent Essence. The darkness lasts 24 hours even if the caster is slain.

name: Swift Spirit of Winged Transportation
description: Summons an air spirit 500 feet long and 200 feet wide that can carry 1,000 tons, lift passengers over a mile and travel at 200 mph; the caster must be onboard or within Essence yards of it.

name: The Battle's End
description: Over a battlefield the caster has full view of (not more than 50 yards away and 100 yards in diameter), and in which he is not participating, spins a purple wheel that compels everyone within the area to lay down their arms; it lasts a number of turns equal to twice the caster's permanent Essence, during which no mortal can lift arms against anyone else. Exalts and God-Blooded may roll Willpower at a difficulty equal to the caster's permanent Essence to act violently, and if they do the spell is broken; the sorcerer is not immune to the compulsion.

name: The Princes of the Fallen Tower
description: Summons a number of rust creatures equal to the caster's permanent Essence that rust metal, erode stone, rot wood and dissolve cloth; their touch ignores 6 soak and deals 8 lethal, and they eat for 25 turns (about 5 hours). They are immune to the Five Magical Materials, enchanted materials and living flesh.

name: The Spawning of Monsters
description: Breeds two species together via a magical acorn to create a new hybrid monster; a mortal mother is killed by the pregnancy, which lasts one-tenth of normal gestation. The offspring inherits the best Traits of both parents, with Storyteller approval.

name: Threefold Binding of the Heart
description: Binds the target's devotion to the caster; mortals are affected instantly, while Essence-users must roll Willpower at a difficulty equal to the caster's permanent Essence. The spell has no effect on creatures of greater permanent Essence, and the bound target may attempt to escape once each year on the anniversary of its birth.

name: Torrential Cascade
description: A wall of water 20 yards high and 100 yards long falls from a body of water at least 50 yards across (the caster within 100 yards), rushing at 300 yards per turn. Fortifications suffer 45 bashing per turn and creatures 15 dice of bashing; Exalts may escape with a Dexterity + Athletics roll at a difficulty equal to the caster's permanent Essence.

name: Unity of Dreams
description: Binds the dreams of participants, who must meditate together for a number of nights (10 motes per participant per night); the binding lasts a number of months equal to the caster's permanent Essence. Participants share dreams and gain a one-die bonus, and any kind of transport ends all effects.

name: Voices of Distant Regard
description: Lets the caster hear conversations about her wherever they occur, until she sleeps; she must roll Perception + Awareness against a difficulty equal to the number of conversations she wishes to follow.

name: Wheel of the Turning Heavens
description: Those of Intelligence greater than 1 within a half-mile radius are caught in the turning of the heavens for half an hour per point of the caster's Essence; victims are unable to act and recall nothing afterwards. Plants and creatures of Intelligence 1 are unaffected.

name: Whirlwind of Fate
description: Grants bonus dice equal to the successes of an Intelligence + Occult roll toward a single named goal, lasting a number of minutes equal to twice the caster's permanent Essence; only one such effect may be active at a time, and if the goal is not pursued the dice become a penalty.

name: Abjuration of the Maidens
description: Protects a region 1 mile in diameter per point of the caster's Essence; a 5-hour preparation inscribes 25 sigils, and the lethal health level cost cannot be soaked. No sorcerous effect crosses the boundary and no Charms or sorcery may be used within it for 5 days; only a creature of greater Essence at the center can counter the spell.

name: Benediction of Archgenesis
description: Returns barren, infertile or drought-stricken land to vibrant fertility, covering up to 100 square miles per point of the caster's permanent Essence; the ritual is cast with a staff of a 1000-year-old tree and runs from sunrise on the new moon of Ascending Water until the next sunrise. A soft warm rain falls until dusk, and by the following year the area teems with thriving, reproducing life; cast on an already-healthy area it brings a famine lasting a decade.

name: Chariot of the Blazing Sun
description: Calls a chariot of golden Essence with five fiery steeds that carries the caster and up to five other people (or 2,000 pounds of cargo) at 750 miles per hour, able to travel anywhere in Creation, through the Wyld or to the Celestial City. It may only be cast between sunrise and sunset; it lasts until it reaches the destination, is dispelled or until sunset, and if the sun leaves the sky while it flies the crash deals 45L to all within. Passengers are protected from extremes of weather and Wyld mutation, and Emerald or Sapphire Circle sorcery cast against the chariot is harmlessly absorbed.

name: Craft the Puissant Sanctum
description: Works much like Raise the Puissant Sanctum but without a design: after attuning to the Demesne and a week's meditation per level of the intended Manse, the sorcerer diverts all the Demesne's Essence flows into herself, shaping the Manse over one day per level. She must be alone in the Demesne, as anyone else risks being incorporated into the structure, and at the end she is at -5 to all actions until she rests enough to regain Willpower; the Manse is more natural and less obviously crafted than others.

name: Curse of Unyielding Mist
description: A fog that will not lift covers a region no larger than 10 square miles per point of the caster's permanent Essence, all under a single name, cast in a one-minute ritual at the region's border; the caster names a condition by which the curse may be lifted. While it holds, clear vision ends at about a yard (attacks beyond five yards are as if blind at +2 difficulty, mundane tracking +3, supernatural trackers +1), social dice pools suffer a two-die penalty, plant growth is inhibited and fungus proliferates. Slaying the caster is not enough — it is susceptible only to the Incarna and Adamant Countermagic cast during the initial casting, otherwise lasting for eternity.

name: Essence Inversion
description: Starts a chain reaction in the target's Essence that annihilates it utterly: after the beam strikes, the target suffers 10L damage every turn until it dies, the spell is countered or the caster dispels the inversion, and this damage can be soaked only with Stamina and Charms. Creatures can only parry or dodge the attack with Charms, and no mortal creature can escape the sorcerer's wrath; when the victim dies, its body implodes, leaving no physical remains.

name: Gaia's Rebuke
description: A circle of earth one yard in diameter larger than the creature and 10 yards thick rises a mile into the sky on a pillar of Essence, then turns upside down and smashes back into the ground, dealing 150 dice of lethal damage to the target and to anything it carries. Creatures standing directly next to the target or being carried by it are shaken free when the earth breaks loose and are not damaged.

name: Incantation of the Invincible Army
description: Blesses allied forces and damns their enemies: allies gain one dot to all Physical Attributes for the duration, while beings opposing a target of the incantation suffer a one-die penalty to attacks, dodges, parries and Valor checks while engaged in combat (under Mail and Steel, allied stacks gain +1 to Valor, Drill, Attack Traits and Might). Up to 5,000 creatures per point of the caster's permanent Essence may be blessed, and the caster must keep her hands raised, taking no other actions, making reflexive Stamina + Endurance and Stamina + Resistance rolls to hold on; the effects end if she loses concentration or is slain, the spell is countered or dispelled, or at the end of the battle.

name: Total Annihilation
description: Hurls an orb up to 200 yards away (Dexterity + Occult or Dexterity + Thrown) that explodes into a column of bright green light 50 yards wide and five miles high, dealing 50 lethal health levels to everything it touches; the emerald field then expands 50 yards in diameter each turn for a number of turns equal to the caster's permanent Essence, dealing 25 lethal each turn bathed in it. The orb can only be parried or dodged with Charms, and a successful parry with an enchanted weapon deflects it 1,000 yards away; once it explodes the effect can only be dodged by a perfect defense or soaked with a Charm such as Adamant Skin Technique. It may be countered successfully only while it is being cast.

name: Cleansing Solar Flames
description: Scours a shadowland out of Creation: it must be cast from the geomantic center of the shadowland, costs 50+ motes (plus 10 for every additional 50 miles of radius beyond the first), and requires 10 minutes of supplication to the Unconquered Sun for every 50 miles of radius the shadowland covers. At its conclusion a tower of near-solid sunlight, visible from tens of miles away, bursts over the region and falls, wiping the darkness away and separating Creation from the Underworld; the sorcerer was invariably protected by her Circle from the nephwracks and mortwights the spell's power drew.

name: Wrath of the Five Elements
description: Calls the Five Elemental Dragons to smite one creature with five separate attacks on consecutive turns: fire for 15L that also burns away unenchanted gear and reduces armor soak by 3; ice for 15L soaked only by Stamina, halving movement and jumping for the scene; envenomed vines whose poison inflicts a four-die penalty to all actions; three stone pillars for 20 bashing and possible knockdown; and a geyser for five lethal levels ignoring armor, leaving the victim unable to speak or invoke Charms for turns equal to the caster's permanent Essence. One Intelligence + Occult roll sets the difficulty to resist, and no successes means the motes are spent for no effect. Each attack may be dodged or parried only with Charms.

name: Assassin's Fatal Touch
description: After a ritual of at least 15 minutes over a touched target or an object they handled, the caster's next light, non-hostile touch deals 5L plus 1L per success on a reflexive Intelligence + Medicine roll, instantly and painlessly; armour does not protect and mortals get no resistance roll, while survivors fall unconscious for (6 - Stamina) turns. Exalted, Fair Folk and spirits roll permanent Essence — one success negates it entirely — and subtract innate lethal soak. It has no effect on the undead, Deathlords or Abyssals, lasts until the touch lands or one full day, allows only one nemesis at a time, and fails if combined with a physical attack.

name: Calling the Stalwart Servitor
description: Summons a clay humanoid about five feet tall that lifts up to 10 tons, moves 10 yards a turn, and digs, builds and performs simple manual tasks. It cannot be ordered to attack and vanishes instantly if struck. It lasts a number of hours equal to the summoner's Essence unless dispelled.

name: Cirrus Skiff
description: A cloud platform carries the sorcerer plus 100 pounds per point of permanent Essence at up to 3 mph per point of permanent Essence. It hovers indefinitely, so it imposes no penalty on Archery or other Abilities needing a steady base. It lasts one scene or until the caster steps off.

name: Coin of Distant Vision
description: A half-hour ritual links a small black ceramic coin to the caster, who can then concentrate to see and hear events around it as though standing there, and always knows its rough distance and direction. Only one coin may be linked at a time; breaking the link takes a turn's concentration and 5 motes, and crumbles the coin.

name: Commanding Presence of Fire
description: A giant flaming image of the caster appears and speaks with him, greatly amplifying his voice and adding his Occult score to Presence dice pools. It lasts one turn, extended each turn by a reflexive Stamina roll to a maximum of one scene; a botch costs one bashing health level and ends it.

name: Curtain of Quartz
description: A globe of hovering crystals reflects light away from the caster: for one scene, all sorcery requiring visual contact, Ability rolls and attacks within three yards suffer -3 successes. The caster is unaffected, and non-visual targeting such as scent is not hindered.

name: Dragon of Smoke/Serpent of Flame
description: A serpentine guidepost of inky smoke by day, and of heatless white flame in darkness giving daylight-equivalent light, winds ahead of the traveller. Guiding to a well-known place needs no roll; finding a place by described properties needs Wits + Occult at difficulty 1-5 by how common those properties are, and unique properties cannot be found at all. It lasts one full day, until the destination is reached, or until dismissed.

name: Droning Suggestion
description: A low hum puts everyone within 10 yards into a light trance, leaving them highly susceptible to plausibly phrased suggestions; listeners resist with a Willpower roll at difficulty 1, rising by 1 per turn of exposure, and completely blocking the ears protects. It lasts as many turns as the caster's permanent Essence, and victims afterwards remember what happened.

name: Empathic Wind
description: Commits the caster's current sense impressions to the wind and carries them to one recipient up to 50 miles per point of permanent Essence away, who relives them for one turn and knows who sent them. A Perception + Awareness roll sets how many senses carry; above five successes the caster's emotions carry as well.

name: The Eye and the Mouth
description: Conjures a floating golden eye that reads any living or dead human language — though not codes — and a golden mouth that dictates the translation. It will not repeat text it has already translated, and both fade after 10 minutes.

name: Floral Ferry
description: Grows a light, seaworthy craft out of any nearby plant. It carries up to a ton of cargo as far as 10 miles per point of the caster's permanent Essence, sails smoothly in all but the worst conditions and shelters its contents from the weather. The caster names the destination as it enters the water, and it sails there in a straight line.

name: Impervious Sphere of Water
description: Surrounds the caster and those beside her in a 10-foot-radius sphere of breathable conjured water that turns aside every attack and hazard from outside — and equally blocks those inside from acting outward. Occupants move as if swimming. The sphere has 20B/20L soak and 25 health levels and must be destroyed before anything reaches them. It lasts only while the caster concentrates and does nothing else.

name: Lesser Golem
description: Raises an elemental warrior from a fistful of earth plus one other element, with the caster's Physical Attributes, one dot of Mental and Social Attributes, the Dawn Caste Abilities at the caster's ratings, and as many -0 health levels as the caster has health. The second element sets its gift: Magma (Fire) doubles Dexterity and movement; Shadow (Air) adds the Night Caste Abilities; Mud (Water) gains two dice defending the caster and is the only golem that acts defensively; Forest (Wood) doubles Strength and Stamina at half movement. Golems attack anyone threatening the caster unless telepathically directed, cannot be healed, and disperse at the end of the scene.

name: Magician's Pleasant Path
description: The caster and up to twice her permanent Essence in fellow travellers, all within 30 yards, find the terrain levelled, the road cleared of snow and debris and the weather flowing around them, with temporary bridges appearing over crossings up to (Essence x 10) yards wide. Travellers make 30 miles a day on foot and up to 100 mounted and pushing. It lasts until the sun next crosses the horizon, and offers no protection from temperature extremes, storms, roadblocks or bandits.

name: Malediction of the Distorted Compass
description: The victim can no longer find her way anywhere — maps are misread, directions mangled, and crossing a small town can take five days; only being led by someone else works. It is delivered at close range with eye contact and resisted with a Willpower roll at a difficulty equal to the sorcerer's Essence, success costing only -1 on all actions for a turn. It ends at the caster's will or the following sunrise.

name: Mirror of Bending Light
description: Bends light around the sorcerer and up to four others held close, cloaking them in illusions of their surroundings for up to an hour. The caster's player rolls Willpower + Occult, and a viewer must beat that total on a reflexive Perception + Awareness roll to notice anything odd. Wounding anyone inside dispels it, and it conceals neither sound, odour nor tracks.

name: The Parting of the Seas
description: Twin summoned giants wade into a body of water and hold it back like a falling screen, opening a dry corridor one yard wide and 100 yards long per point of the caster's permanent Essence. It lasts only while the caster concentrates — walking and simple talk are fine, anything vigorous dissipates it — and anyone still between the walls when the giants let go takes massive bashing damage from the impact before facing drowning and whatever lives there.

name: Purifying Flames
description: Heatless white flames sear corruption out of food and drink, rendering all non-magical poisons inert and halting rot. It can cleanse a fouled well, or cure poison in as many people as the caster's permanent Essence, rendering it inert inside the body. Damage already done is not healed.

name: Shadowy Simulacrums of Smoke
description: Dark smoke fills a 15-yard radius around the caster: attacks and Perception checks into or within it are at +2 difficulty and every roll made inside is hindered, the caster alone excepted. A solidified-smoke simulacrum forms for each person in the cloud; every other character rolls reflexive Perception + Awareness at a difficulty equal to the caster's permanent Essence to tell the real from the false, and a botch mistakes an ally for an enemy. Simulacrums pop when hit but re-form while the cloud lasts. It lasts a scene; winds over 30 mph reduce its difficulties and a sustained wind disperses it.

name: Shedding the Serpent's Skin
description: The caster sheds a motionless shell of his own skin as a decoy; it is felled by a single blow and crumbles to powder, looking as though he teleported clear. Undisturbed it lasts two turns per five motes spent. Cast unobserved, it grants a Stealth bonus equal to the turns the shell would last, declining as those turns pass.

name: Song of the Waves
description: Conjures a water elemental shaped like the head and forelimbs of a horse surging from a wave, which breathes water and symphonic force at one victim. The caster's player rolls Manipulation + Occult plus automatic successes equal to permanent Essence; the victim soaks with Willpower and the remaining successes are rolled as damage, each success enchanting him for one turn to attack every apparent enemy of the caster, friend or foe. Victims know exactly who to blame afterwards.

name: Song of Vertigo
description: A high wail heard 50 yards around leaves everyone feeling the ground shift beneath them, and all affected act at -3 dice. Only living creatures that can hear are affected — the undead, constructs, animate objects, the deaf and the caster are immune. It lasts one scene unless dispelled or the caster is incapacitated.

name: Spoke the Wooden Face

cost.raw: 10 motes to carve the face, 5 motes to speak through it

description: An overnight ritual carves the sorcerer's likeness into a living tree, channelling 10 motes uninterrupted and completed with a Perception + Crafts roll. Afterwards a turn's concentration and 5 motes let her see, hear and speak through the face at any distance. While linked she perceives nothing around her own body, and an attack requires a Stamina + Resistance roll at a difficulty equal to the damage dealt to keep contact.

name: Stalwart Earth Guardian
description: The caster scribes a figure up to 20 yards across, and the earth inside it turns against all intruders until she leaves the region. Sand and soil try to swallow anyone approaching within 10 yards of the boundary while stones strike and trip: trespassers cannot approach silently, cannot move faster than seven feet a turn, and take eight dice of soakable bashing damage every turn. Everyone inside the figure is immune to attack, interlopers included.

name: Summoning of the Harvest
description: Accelerates the natural cycles of every pregnant creature and harvestable plant within 50 yards: within five turns crops are ready and animals have given birth unharmed. It cannot hasten the pregnancy of intelligent creatures.

name: The Titan's Icy Breath
description: The head and shoulders of a giant frozen humanoid rise and loose a gout of freezing wind, sheathing everything in its path in ice before shattering it. The caster's player rolls Wits + Occult with automatic successes equal to his Occult score; those caught soak lethal damage equal to the result, and any creature taking even one level has its movement halved for the scene.

name: Tongue of the Element Spirit
description: A flickering tongue of elemental energy over the caster's head grants dice in one Eclipse Caste Ability, one die per point of permanent Essence, chosen by element: Air gives Linguistics (each die also granting one more spoken language family), Earth gives Bureaucracy, Flame gives Socialize, Water gives Sail and Wood gives Ride. The bonus may never exceed the caster's current rating in that Ability, the total may not exceed 5, and it does not count as base Ability for Charm doubling. It lasts one scene.

name: Venom of the Heart
description: The target, who may be the caster, becomes poisonous: blood and saliva turn to lethal poison, her kiss is deadly, and anything that eats part of her dies in agony. A victim who kisses or consumes any part of her takes lethal damage equal to the caster's permanent Essence, soaked only by Stamina and never rolled. It lasts until the target next eats or drinks.

name: The Violent Opening of Closed Portals
description: Blows every non-magical door in a single continuous structure off its hinges, shattering flimsy ones. Cast from inside a doorless room it instead blasts an oval opening up to three yards by two through the nearest wall, piercing walls over 30 feet thick. The caster must be touching or inside the structure, and doors behind magical wards are unaffected.

name: Water from Stone
description: Struck after the invocation, a large boulder begins to trickle and within minutes cuts a new stream of pure, drinkable water, enough for as many men or animals as the combined permanent Willpower of the caster and the witnesses. The witnesses may not outnumber the caster's Occult dots. The stream lasts years where water is abundant, months in average country and days in arid regions.

name: Written Upon the Water
description: Inscribes a message on the surface of the body of liquid nearest the target, anywhere in the world, appearing once at writing speed and vanishing the moment the target looks away. The caster may write no more words than his permanent Essence, and may only address someone he has personally met.

name: The Crumbling Walls
description: A ritual in which the sorcerer and four hand-picked allies march five full circuits around a city, at least one circuit a day, taking no part in violence and unable to parry or dodge (though soak Charms still work). As each circuit completes, a shadow image of Saturn, Maiden of Endings, appears at one of the city's five corners; when the fifth appears all five make the sign of Saturn and the defensive walls shake and collapse in a cloud of dust. It harms nothing but the outer walls, and the Essence stays committed until they fall.

name: Venus' Disfavor
description: Chanted over at least two full turns, each turn past the first adding a die to the Charisma + Occult check, it looses a swirling mass of burning dust that afflicts every creature within 100 yards per point of the caster's permanent Essence + Willpower with festering boils, sparing the caster and his chosen allies. The boils do no damage, but mortals must make daily Stamina + Endurance checks merely to function and suffer -1 die on all actions regardless; animals turn on anyone who provokes them; and Exalted make the same daily check to avoid the penalty. It lasts a lunar month unless countermagic breaks it.

name: Voice of Distant Command
description: An hour-long ritual enchants a small item worn by the target, who need be neither willing nor conscious. The caster may then communicate mentally at any distance, and the target obeys her commands while unaware he is controlled; truly extreme orders allow a Willpower roll at difficulty 2, and resisting half a dozen such orders breaks the spell. It holds while the target stays within 5 yards of the item. A caster may control as many targets as her permanent Willpower, and Exalted may only control mortals and beings of lower permanent Essence than their own.

name: Enemy of Nature
description: Makes the target the mortal enemy of every normal animal and plant for a lunar month: nearby life attacks, and a targeted city, army or fleet is ruined as water is fouled, food devoured and mounts turn on their riders. The target may be no larger than a single city, army or fleet. Individuals almost certainly die within days; over three quarters of a town's population dies and every survivor takes at least three levels of lethal damage, two for extras. The caster must be within sight to cast it, and only the targeted group is affected.

name: Light of Solar Cleansing
description: For a full day no undead, Deathlord or Abyssal may approach within (Essence x 2) yards of the caster, and his skin glows as brightly as clear morning for (Essence x 5) yards. For 5 more motes he may instantly slay a single undead standing within that light, or deal a Deathlord or deathknight aggravated health levels equal to his permanent Essence. Only one such attack may be made in a turn.

name: Loyal Golem
description: A far more resilient kin of the Lesser Golem: it has its creator's Attributes and Dawn Caste Abilities, full use of Mental Attributes, free will, fierce loyalty (an effective Willpower of 10 against being turned against its creator), and halves all unsoaked damage. It heals at a human rate while in contact with earth and its other component element, and if reduced to zero health levels it re-forms a fortnight later at full health. It always senses its master's location. A sorcerer may have only one at a time, and it serves a year and a day.

name: Mirage of Protective Shelter
description: For a full year, anyone approaching a protected camp or city intending to conquer it or harm its people simply cannot find it — besieging armies included, along with their domestic animals — growing dizzier and more disoriented the closer they come, and wandering off the road. Thieves, lone assassins, merchants and diplomats are unaffected, and anyone attacked by the inhabitants is immune for the next full scene. Only Adamant Countermagic defeats it outright, though magical sight can lead in up to a dozen blindfolded, roped-together mortal soldiers.

name: Mystic Travel
description: Anointed travellers on a road, trail, frozen river or well-defined sea route move at up to 2,000 miles a day, diverted around every obstacle and threat, the landscape misty to either side, arriving as if they had marched a few hours in ideal conditions. Up to 10,000 people may be moved; anything unanointed is left behind, and only physically breaking the road ends it early.

name: Pressed Beyond the Veil of Time
description: A year-and-a-day ritual sends a named structure or region Elsewhere, where it cannot be seen, felt or visited, returning for one whole day at intervals set by a trigger event chosen at the start. Time compresses Elsewhere in proportion to the interval: a month between reappearances makes a week in Creation a day inside, while centuries make a year a day. The caster must build an exact replica (Perception + Craft, difficulty 5) and feed it to a fire on hourglass sand for the year and a day, never leaving it. The effect is permanent unless the trigger can be prevented from occurring.

name: Solar Sanctuary
description: Five pre-prepared statues are placed at the five corners of an enclosed region and the caster, at its highest point, chants three full turns to close a mystic dome over it. Inside, the unExalted have their memories of events dimmed and mortals present at the casting take -1 die resisting the caster and his allies; every Demesne becomes a Manse dedicated to the caster and every Manse rises to its Demesne's level, drawable from anywhere inside; existing Hearthstones go powerless while new ones form in days equal to their Manse's rating; the caster may see through any corner statue; and Charms and spells cast inside cost half, provided their effects do not reach beyond it. The statues have 24B/12L soak and 500 health levels and heal 10 levels an hour, and breaking one ends the otherwise permanent spell. Sanctuaries may not overlap except at a shared corner statue.

name: Soul Seal
description: A ritual that removes the mind and soul of a willing, living subject and stores them in a vessel, the first step toward immortality. The vessel is a hollow container the size of a human head made of all Five Magical Materials, into which caster and subject imbue five chosen qualities, at least a week each. The subject undergoes years of training and diet, a nine-day fast in a lightless chamber and a bathing in the waterfalls at the world's five corners, while the caster spends a year etching each surface of the chamber. The vessel can only be broken by someone with Craft, Lore and Occult of 4 or higher, a sorcerous workroom and several weeks of effort.

name: Summon Animal Avatar
description: Summons the living avatar of any normal animal species the caster has seen — a fully intelligent spirit that commands and shares the senses of every animal of its type within 100 miles. The avatar is well disposed but under no compulsion, and any attempt to coerce it earns its instant enmity; it must be bargained with, its price set by how the character has treated that species. It will not agree to bring harm to large numbers of its own kind unless doing so avoids greater harm. Its Physical Attributes equal a normal member's +4, with Charisma 6, Manipulation 5, Appearance 6, Perception 5, Intelligence 5, Wits 5, all Virtues 4, Abilities at 5 (Presence, Occult and Survival 6), Backgrounds at 5 and all spirit Charms.

name: Technique Mirror
description: For one scene the sorcerer can duplicate any Charm used in his presence while the spell is active, regardless of its normal prerequisites, and may substitute the original owner's Traits for his own where they are superior — but only for using that Charm, and he pays every cost himself. Charms observed before the casting do not count unless performed again in front of him. There is no limit on how many are stolen, and all are instantly forgotten when the spell ends.

name: Theft of Years
description: Each turn the spell operates, the sorcerer and victim make opposed Willpower + Essence rolls: on every turn the sorcerer accumulates more successes the victim ages ten years, with all the normal effects of age, and the sorcerer grows one year younger. Accumulating fewer successes for five turns running ruptures the spell and returns both to their original ages. The caster may stop at any point, but it is usually continued until the victim ages to death.

name: Unity of the Closed Fist
description: Merges up to five conscious, willing individuals into a single composite being: its height is the tallest member's plus 25 percent per extra member; its Strength and Stamina are the greatest present plus one dot per extra member; its health levels are the largest set plus one -1 and two -2 levels per extra member, always starting undamaged; and every other Attribute or Ability is the best any member possesses. It can use any contributor's Charms, pools their Essence, fuses their Hearthstones into a single emerald stone in its forehead, and bears composite armour and a weapon built from the best each carried. Contributors are unharmed when it ends normally, but are ejected at a single health level if it is destroyed. It lasts one scene per point of the caster's permanent Essence, and may be cast only once per day.

name: The Whisperers in the Mirror
description: Shadows lurk in every reflective surface the target passes, whispering that his friends and allies betray him. Each time he looks into one his player rolls Willpower reflexively against the sorcerer's, and after 10 failed rolls he is clinically paranoid; continued exposure drives him fully insane, the form — catatonia, schizophrenia or homicidal mania — depending on his personality and fears. Only Adamant Countermagic or the sorcerer's death banishes the whisperers, and that death does not cure the insanity already caused.

name: Winds of Confusion
description: A howling gale strips memory and purpose for a mile around: anyone not sheltered by terrain or solid walls loses a dot of Intelligence each turn, and those reduced to none wander mindlessly with no volition. Sheltering or leaving the area restores a lost dot every two turns. It lasts a full hour, and the caster alone is safe — the winds part for him. Afterwards Intelligence returns at a dot per turn, but memories of the period stay blurred.

name: Song of the Lintha
description: Taught to the Lintha Terrestrial Exalted by Dukantha, a ritual spell that takes six days to fully cast. For the whole of the casting period the caster must keep her eyes closed and remain in a state of concentration and meditation. On the sixth day she sings a repeating three-note, seven-syllable song that grows in volume and power as the day proceeds and virulent Infernal energies coalesce around her. When the spell is complete a door of black putrescent flesh appears before her as she opens her eyes. The door does not open: the caster, or anyone else present when the spell is finished, may enter by slicing the thick flesh open with a blade forged of one of the Five Magical Materials and sliding her body into the dripping wound, emerging in an exitless cave of hard black stone — a chancre on the heel of Malfeas, a place where the Yozi can hear the voice of a mortal and either send a minion to speak with the caster, or cut the chancre off, hurling everyone inside into the emptiness beyond knowing, forever lost. Should the Yozi — specifically Kimberry, the Sea That Marched Against the Flame — deign to hear, she will send Dukantha or some demon of strength commensurate with the importance of the request and how sympathetic she is at that moment. The minion may be more or less delighted to see the caster, but will listen to her petition. In the case of a demon some price must be paid, especially if the requested service requires immediate action; as Dukantha is a Lintha himself he may be inclined to offer aid, especially if the request is in line with the interests of the Great Mother.

name: Water's Ally
description: For a day and a night the caster becomes kin to water and can exist in water or air with equal ease. She can swim at the same speed as she moves upon land, may breathe water or air, and can see underwater just as she can in the air. She is not affected by the water's crushing depths or its chilling cold, and while in the water she may add two dice to her Stealth dice pool as she blends into the deep colours. The spell provides no protection against predators or other active threats of the ocean — it merely adapts the caster for existence in the water, and a sorcerer has to deal with the creatures of the depths on her own.

name: Transference of the Sanctum
description: Allows an Exalted to transfer a small god's sanctum into the mortal world. If the sanctum is modeled on the spirit's charge, such as a tree or a building, the sanctum physically replaces that object. Until the sun next crosses the horizon the sanctum is physically present and accessible to all mortals and Exalted, and anything removed from it remains in the mortal world once the spell ends; at the spell's end the sanctum and everything inside it dematerializes and is replaced by whatever was previously in that location. The caster need not fight the sanctum's owner to move it, although she may have to battle an angry spirit once the spell has been cast. The spell can also be used to move a small god's sanctum into the mortal world PERMANENTLY. To accomplish this prodigious feat the caster must perform a complex ritual lasting from sunrise to sunset; unless she has the permission of all the sanctum's current residents, at the end of the ritual the sorcerer's player must make an opposed Willpower + Essence roll with the Storyteller for each and every spirit that has made the sanctum its home. Every 5 motes of temporary Essence the caster spends reduces the Essence + Willpower dice pool of her current opponent by one die. In addition to fighting these spirits, many small gods call upon all their allies when their home is attacked in such a direct fashion. A sanctum may make a wonderfully secure new home and can be used as the basis for a potent Manse, but capturing one belonging to a powerful spirit often requires an epic battle. The spell can only be used upon sanctums controlled by spirits whose permanent Essence is no greater than the caster's — it is impossible to affect the sanctums of the greatest gods with it.

name: Gift of Knowledge
description: Allows the sorcerer to directly transfer knowledge of a particular subject or skill to another individual. The spell requires an hour-long ritual during which the sorcerer and the subject must be in physical contact; both enter a deep meditative trance, and knowledge flows from the sorcerer to the subject. It can impart a particular memory or experience, or understanding of a particular Trait including Abilities, specialties, spells or Charms. It does not work on Essence. The spell obviates the need for training time for the Sidereal to learn the subject or improve the Trait, so long as the caster's rating in that Trait is greater than the subject's. The subject must still have sufficient experience to improve the Trait's rating, and can only improve a Trait by one dot per casting, as she must still integrate the acquired knowledge — though multiple castings can allow a subject to increase a Trait in hours rather than weeks or months. Gift of Knowledge does not grant subjects the ability to learn Traits they cannot normally acquire, so it cannot teach a mortal to use Exalted Charms, for example, or teach a spell to a character who cannot cast it.

name: Open the Spirit Door
description: Allows the caster and anyone she cares to bring with her to physically enter the sanctum of any spirit with an Essence equal to or lower than the caster's. She can also use it to enter the sanctums of more powerful spirits, but only with the owner's permission. The spell does allow the caster to dematerialize, it can only be used to enter a small god's sanctum, and the caster rematerializes when he leaves. To cast it, the caster and everyone she is bringing must be within three yards of one of the sanctum's entrances. To locate a sanctum the caster can either ask a spirit, use the Spirit Detecting Glance Charm, or perform a complex divination requiring several hours and a Perception + Occult roll at difficulty 3; on a success the Exalt has located all sanctum entrances within a 100-yard radius. Once the entrance has been found the caster and her companions need only stand before it and cast, and in the next instant they all find themselves on the threshold of the sanctum. For the duration everyone under its influence can interact physically with the sanctum and all its inhabitants and furnishings. The spell lasts until the sun next crosses the horizon; if the caster wishes to leave before then she can simply cast it again, and she and everyone she brings will find themselves back in the mortal world. Regardless of how they leave, they always find themselves back in the exact place where the spell was first cast — a number of clever Exalted have used it to hide from mundane pursuit, but it cannot be used to intangibly move through space. Anyone using this spell can carry items and furnishings out of the sanctum so long as she can pick them up and carry them. Spirits generally object strongly to having their sanctums invaded by greedy or aggressive Exalted, and anyone known to make a habit of attacking the sanctums of small gods will eventually have to deal with the wrath of more powerful spirits who object to their underlings being harmed or robbed. The spell can also be used to gain entrance to the Celestial City of Yu-Shan, but anyone entering in this fashion must also talk their way past the celestial lions who guard it.

name: Summoning the Heavenly Portal
description: As the personal servants and messengers of the Five Maidens, the Sidereal Exalted were given knowledge of how to actually summon the Calibration Gate. To cast it the Exalt must meditate and pray for five minutes, at the end of which the caster's player rolls the character's Essence + Occult. On a failure, some other Celestial Exalted used this spell recently and the gate is not available; if the caster rolls even a single success, the gateway appears within arm's reach. The gateway normally stays until the next dawn, and it may not be summoned by another Exalt for half an hour after the caster summoned it. The spell is available to any Sidereal who wishes to learn it, and all of them know of its existence. So far no member of the Gold Faction has taught it to any of the Solar Exalted they are mentoring, and almost no Solars even know it exists — even the Gold Faction fear what might happen if the Solars could travel as easily as they do, though all Sidereals know it is only a matter of time before some Solar learns it. A handful of Lunar Exalted of the No Moon Caste know this spell, but guard it jealously and will only give it to other Lunars they consider truly worthy. Although they are normally capable of learning Celestial Circle Sorcery, Abyssal Exalted are incapable of casting this spell — their nature is too antithetical to Heaven's for them to possess any ability to command it. The spell can only be cast in Creation and can only be used to call the gateway to the caster. A Sidereal can use it to gain access to Yu-Shan in less than 10 minutes, but once in Yu-Shan the caster cannot move this gateway; instead, an Exalt desiring to move rapidly from one portion of Creation to another must summon the gateway, enter Yu-Shan and then leave it via another gateway near her destination.

name: Water's Chilling Grasp
description: The sorcerer causes a number of chill tentacles of water equal to twice her permanent Essence to rise up from the waters surrounding a nearby vessel — no further than 100 x permanent Essence yards from her — and attack that ship's crew. Each tentacle is up to 30 feet long and attacks once a turn without direction, randomly attempting to grab a crewmember, lifting him from the deck and constricting him in its cold grasp. Each tentacle has an Initiative of 6 and an Attack of 5, and does 8 bashing damage per turn that a foe is in its coils. The tentacles attack as a group: roll one attack and compare it to each defender's dodge or parry separately, so if the tentacles roll 3 successes each defender needs 4 successes to avoid being grabbed. Only one tentacle will attack each target. If attacked, the tentacles do not dodge or soak and take 20 health levels of damage before dispersing; edged weapons do half damage to them, fire-based weapons double. If the sorcerer wishes, he can take an action and directly control one tentacle, using his own Melee pool to attack at a two-dice penalty, or he can reform a tentacle that has been 'slain', although this takes the entire turn. The tentacles last a number of turns equal to the caster's permanent Essence + 2 and then dissolve, leaving the enemy vessel awash in water and any victims either in the ocean or dashed to the decks (50 percent chance of either). Players of victims who fall to the deck must make a Dexterity + Athletics roll at difficulty 2 to avoid an additional 8B damage from the fall. Victims that fall into the ocean take no damage but will have to be rescued, and will start drowning if they cannot swim. If attacking in group combat, add the caster's Essence rather than her Charisma to a single attack roll, and add 2 to the damage of the attack for each tentacle after the first.

name: Storm Rider Enchantment
description: With the aid of this spell a ship can travel in even the mightiest storm without fear or danger, even taking advantage of the storm's power to lend speed to its journey. Cast when a ship first encounters a storm, it renders the vessel totally immune to the storm's effects; if cast while the ship is already in the storm, the spell has no effect. For the duration — as long as the storm or three days, whichever is shorter — no lightning will strike the ship nor waves dash over its decks. The enchanted ship will sail safely over the deepest swells and the highest waves and remain calm under even the fiercest winds. The ship has only slight control over where it goes, but will at least keep somewhat on course for its destination if the navigator and helmsmen are competent; this requires Wits or Stamina + Sail rolls for each, with the difficulty ranging from 2 to 4 depending on the ferocity of the storm, and the player or Storyteller may choose whether to use Wits or Stamina, as both quick thinking and dogged determination can see one through a storm safely. If the storm is traveling in the same general direction as the vessel was heading, the ship will benefit from its passage, typically cutting one to two days — or more in the case of truly savage storms, up to a week — from the length of the journey.

name: Summon Spirit Boat

cost.raw: 30 motes base, +2 motes per additional day of existence

description: The sorcerer calls forth a sailing ship constructed of pure Essence to take him where he wants to go. This spirit-crafted vessel remains in existence for a week and a day, plus one day for every additional 2 motes spent, during which it will go wherever the sorcerer commands without need of crew or navigator. A simple command such as 'Take me to the city of Lookshy by the most direct path' suffices to set course and set the vessel upon its journey. If the sorcerer desires, he may place the vessel under the command of another by merely commanding the ship to take her orders as it would his own, and he may also place restrictions upon this gift as desired — the ship will understand moderately complicated conditions and restrictions placed upon its usage and follow them accordingly. The vessel appears fully stocked with provisions and takes whatever form the sorcerer requests, so long as it is a fine one: the spirits will not create a crippled-looking scow or an aged rowboat, instead interpreting these commands in ways that better suit their aesthetic sensibilities. There are limits to the size of the vessel this spell can create — ships as large as a large yacht or a small coaster are within its ability, but a ship as large as a blue-water merchant is beyond it. While on a course, the vessel travels at three times the normal speed for a ship of its kind, even against the wind or tides, and it will cleverly avoid reefs, shoals and other submerged hazards. It provides no inherent protection against predators or the weather, but local spirits will generally not harass those aboard such a ship unless ordered to do so by another sorcerer who holds sway over them, or by their superiors in their spirit court. If attacked, the spirit ship has twice the soak and health levels of a vessel of its type, but it is not armed and will attempt to run, not fight.

name: Swift Journey
description: This spell enables the vessel it is cast upon to travel incredible distances in just a single day. When it is cast, the sorcerer specifies a destination, which must be no further away than 1,500 miles times the caster's permanent Essence. So long as the final stopping point is within that range, the journey will take no more than a full day from the time the spell is cast. The crew and passengers will notice nothing unusual about their journey, save that it takes such a short time. While this spell is in effect, only great powers such as elemental dragons, the gods and perhaps elder Sidereals and the like can interfere with the ship until it reaches its goal.

name: The Ravenous Fire
description: Target: One inanimate object. This spell conjures a magical fire that will consume any non-magical material as if it were dry timber. The sorcerer concentrates on the spell for a turn and then points at the object she wishes to incinerate. A jet of blue-white flame shoots from her fingertip up to one yard away and will instantly ignite the substance at which she points. Dead wood will be instantly consumed. Granite will soften and burn like candle wax. Metals will crumble to ash and slag under the heat of the ravenous fire. The flames will only consume the material to which it was first set, but they can spread to any other material of the same type as long as it is in contact with the substance first touched. Thus, if the sorcerer were to set fire to a marble pillar, it would spread to any other marble that pillar touches, such as the floor or the ceiling. It would not, however, burn any metal inlays or gems set into the marble. The Ravenous Fire can consume 27 cubic feet (the size of a human-sized statue and base) for every point of permanent Essence the caster possesses, and it takes approximately one minute to consume that 27 cubic feet.

name: Oblivion's Avatar

cost.raw: 10 motes (committed) per power, or 40 motes and 5 experience points per power to make the effect permanent

description: Target: One war machine. Animating a war machine is sometimes just the first step in creating a truly devastating weapon. Oblivion's Avatar invests a walking war machine with a portion of the power of the Malfeans themselves, granting it the ability to carry pure entropy into Creation, which might manifest as a black nimbus of destruction akin to Crypt Bolt or (Material) Withering Method (see Exalted: The Abyssals pp. 191 and 187-188, respectively), the ability to spread disease or some other form of direct channeling of Oblivion into the realm of the living. The prayer-blocking ability of the weapon of mephitic desolation is a product of this spell. Other examples of the power of Oblivion's Avatar are listed in the sidebar “Necromantic Weaponry” on page 109.
